summary: Megan Holdings Ltd., a Cayman Islands-incorporated foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its Extraordinary General Meeting held on August 21, 2026. Shareholders holding 90.86% of voting power approved three routine capital-arc proposals: a 40-for-1 share consolidation, a par value reduction credited to share premium, and an authorized share capital increase. These actions are standard corporate housekeeping and do not constitute a special situation, tender offer, restructuring, or strategic transaction. No deal terms, premiums, advisors, or recommendations were disclosed. This is a routine EGM outcome report with no market-moving event; no risk-arb angle applies.
